online_means: requires a real sandboxed Wwise WAAPI connection; it does not mean internet access
inventory_source: five-version union of packaged CapabilityCatalog executable entries

prompt_materialization.render_timing: before the fresh Codex task starts
prompt_materialization.required_argument_rule: every raw required call argument must be literal in the prompt, supplied as a visible input, or obtained by a declared supporting dispatch
prompt_materialization.hidden_boundary: independent oracle GUIDs, hashes, controls, and expected readbacks remain model-invisible

isolation.codex_task: one scenario per fresh CLI process, thread, and memory-isolated task
isolation.mutation_confirmation: each packaged mutation call receives its own natural confirmation turn in the same fresh task after an immutable preview; the confirmation applies only to the currently visible preview
isolation.wwise_lifecycle: version-scoped, lane-appropriate isolated host lifecycles; GUI, WwiseConsole, and runtime profiles are never conflated
isolation.scenario_namespace: unique runner-owned object and file namespace
isolation.source_project: immutable; hash and mtime attested before and after the campaign
isolation.success_cleanup: remove scenario-owned state and delete the sandbox after final version verification
isolation.failure_cleanup: for a failed or indeterminate case, retain the sandbox and sealed evidence, mark it quarantined, and never reuse it for another scenario; never report a skip or blocked prerequisite as a pass
